design: Three paired fresh-context constructions. Fixed alternating launch order, both arms concurrently where capacity permits. All three pairs run irrespective of earlier results. An additional equal-content ordinary-reuse construction uses the independently implemented conventional first asset.
models: All use inherited included agent configuration with fork_turns=none and no model/reasoning overrides. Exact weights, sampling parameters, inference calls and token accounting unavailable. Same configured model is procedural equality, not verified deterministic identity.
information_control: Identical outcome, fixtures, research access and TASK. Only a qualified recovery asset and its API description differ between matched arms. No central second-construction rule supplied. Blinding procedural, not OS-enforced. No other-arm feedback, source or private material reaches constructors.
primary_outcome: Independent pass/fail on all frozen primary second-stage checks. No hidden-result repair in the registered experiment.
secondary_measures: new source bytes/lines and retained dependencies
interpretation: Report every outcome and each paired difference. Three pairs cannot establish broad generality or a strong population causal estimate. Elapsed latency includes inference, tool orchestration and scheduling; it is not complete compute or economic cost. Code reuse is expected conventional engineering and is not by itself improved-inventor evidence.
whole_sequence_cost: Retain first discovery/acquisition/construction/verification plus second integration/construction/verification/execution, failures, and research overhead. Separately report marginal second-task measures. Unknown money, model-host compute, maintenance, hardware realization and downstream productive benefit are not set to zero. Do not claim net economic savings without sufficient complete measured costs.
strong_alternative: Independent conventional first asset also passed the same 824 first-stage checks. The ordinary-reuse route tests whether any benefit is ordinary reusable recovery rather than a special architecture advantage. No actual human-only productivity comparator is available; do not invent one.
selection_rule: Use a source that passes the complete independent contract. If multiple pass, prefer simplicity, numerical performance and robust conditioning; any final packaging/source edits require source-matched requalification and do not rewrite frozen construction outcomes.
scope: CPU mathematical protocol and software construction for MONTREAL.AI research. Not hardware operation, quantum speedup, world novelty, external revenue, funded enterprise, universal optimum or RSI.
private_qualification: Independent evaluator freezes cases/checker before candidate submissions, does not inspect source, withholds results from constructors. Publicly release compact scientific inputs/checker after all sources frozen.
